name: eval-stack
description: Self-host a local, governed evaluation stack for agent skills: ironside (trace store), coeval (judged evaluation with human adjudication), casefile (supply-chain scanning), and a pi session tracer. One skill walks an agent through standing it all up, wiring capture, and authoring calibrated judges; a second runs the findings-driven maintenance loop that patches judged skills under golden-gate and human-merge discipline.
